name: Crop Cycle Bed
description: A bed this cycle occupies. Area comes from upande_core.Bed.

fields.label: Fraction Planted
fields.description: 1.0 for a whole bed. Set by a decimal in the range (22.5 -> 0.5), or override it and the plant count below directly for an odd partial bed.

fields.label: Plants
fields.description: Auto-filled from bed area x density; type a real count for a partial bed instead. This is the original planting and never shrinks -- that stays the investment for costing.

fields.label: Plants Remaining
fields.description: Plants (a share of the row's Uproot Log entries, split across beds by how much each still had standing) after every logged uproot on this bed. Recomputed every save.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Recomputed from Uproot Log every save.
